line: update v0.4.6: smarter pathfinding, faster edit speed, added caucasus

items.text: riders take the line that gets them to their stop first, or now and then just the first train that comes, so expresses and slower locals both get their share, and trams at street stops have no boarding cost
items.edited: smarter pathfinding: passengers will take faster express routes significantly more

items.text: a reversal partway along a line limits its trains no more than turning at its ends does, and its icon shows only where it is what limits the line
items.edited: trains reversing partway through a line no longer restricts throughput as much

items.text: added busways, a track type for buses only, built off the streets like tram track; any bus on one runs 60 km/h
items.edited: added busways, off-street bus paths! and constructible BRT stations

items.text: the station tool picks train or tram, BRT station or port; BRT stations snap to bus routes, ports no longer need a ferry line, and stations can go on open ground again with two clicks
items.edited: can manually specify station type when placing, and can place stations off track

items.text: brt is built like a blueprint: click the upgrade on a bus line, its new lanes show on the map, and construct pays for them; built lanes get a thin dashed border
items.edited: brt upgrades are now blueprints paid for with construct, and built lanes have a dashed border

items.text: trams brake more gently and new tram lines stand 30 s at a stop, as trains do
items.edited: tram acceleration / dwell time matched to trains

items.text: added Ctrl+click to place a manual bus stop exactly where you point, without snapping to a station
items.edited: added Ctrl+click to place a manual bus stop without snapping to a station

items.text: station tool icons and the placing tooltip are coloured by mode
items.edited: station and track tools are coloured by mode

items.text: fixed trams, trains and buses drifting off their track on curves
fixed the track ghost wiggling while drawing and vanishing for a moment after a click
items.edited: fixed the track ghost wiggling, jumping or pointing off while drawing, after a click or after zooming

items.text: fixed quick edits right after another acting on the old map, like deleting the wrong track
items.edited: fixed edits made right after another acting on the old map, like deleting the wrong track

items.text: fixed changing a line whose two directions use different stops or track, which could make every edit fail and stop saving until a reload
items.edited: fixed editing a line with different stops or track per direction breaking edits and saving

items.text: added the keihan main line and 18 other lines missing from kansai's and nagoya's real networks
fixed removing single track being refused with a one-way warning
items.edited: fixed a false one-way warning when removing single track

items.text: fixed track not being placed by touch in firefox on android
items.edited: fixed placing track by touch in firefox on android

items.text: split the huge Muzaffarpur zone into Muzaffarpur, Hajipur and Samastipur, and drew Manila smaller, with San Pablo City and Lipa City as new zones around it
items.edited: redrew hokkaido, manila, muzaffarpur regions

items.text: every stop on an auto bus line now counts for trips, so auto lines carry about a quarter more riders
items.edited: auto bus lines now count every stop for trips and carry about a quarter more riders

items.text: bus stops connect on foot to stops and stations within 150 m, down from 300 m, drawn as a dashed line; a passage at a brt station saves one minute on each change
items.edited: bus stop auto-connections drawn fainter, can manually re-make passageways

items.text: big airports draw ground trips from farther away, so more of incheon's trips come from seoul
items.edited: big airports draw ground trips from farther away

items.text: trips to islands with no road or flight show as no route in the city panel until a ferry or line carries them
items.edited: trips to unconnected islands show as no route until a ferry or line reaches them

items.text: a brt lane takes 60 buses an hour each way, and lines sharing a full lane run fewer buses
items.edited: BRT lanes are constructible and sharable between BRT routes

items.text: added a switch in the line panel's stop list to make a stop boarding only or getting off only
items.edited: added a stop-list toggle to make a stop boarding only or disembarking only

items.text: a line that changes kind (to high speed or tram) takes the new kind's default headways, unless you changed its headways
items.edited: lines that switch to high speed or tram take their default headways unless manually edited

items.text: fixed timetables having an express run through a local before the first station with passing tracks
items.edited: fixed expresses running through locals before the first station with passing tracks

items.text: fixed a line on full track keeping its old frequency after a new train count or headway
items.edited: fixed lines on full track keeping their old frequency after changing train count or headway

items.text: BRT lines have their own fare multiple, and advanced fares shows only the boat sizes and BRT you use, in two columns
items.edited: BRT lines have their own fare multiple, and unused boat sizes and BRT are hidden in advanced fares

items.text: added a toggle to hide all blueprints
items.edited: added a toggle to hide all blueprints, blueprints hidden on community saves

items.text: click again to cycle through overlapping bus, tram and train routes
fixed longer trips to far parts of the same zone, like Madison to La Crosse, not showing when a bubble is selected
items.edited: fixed long same-zone trips not showing when you select a bubble

items.text: added bookmarks to Community: a bookmark button on each network and a Bookmarked tab, kept with your account when signed in
items.edited: added bookmarks to community saves

items.text: community saves open paused with blueprints hidden, and leaving one you haven't changed no longer asks first
items.edited: community saves open paused with blueprints hidden

items.text: viewing a community network no longer calculates its trips unless you tick calculate trips, so it loads much faster
items.edited: community networks no longer calculate trips (by default) so they load faster

items.text: after an edit, lines' riders start moving once the first period's trips are calculated, about 10 s on a 2,000-station save instead of 40 s
items.edited: after an edit, lines' riders start moving once the first period's trips are calculated

items.text: trips are calculated 9% faster after an edit
added calculate trips in less detail, a setting that calculates trips faster after a load or an edit; it starts on for phones and tablets
items.edited: added "calculate trips in less detail", a faster setting, on by default on phones and tablets

items.text: small games load about a third faster (a 4-line montana game 12.6 s to 8.6 s)
items.edited: games in sparse areas load up to 30% faster

items.text: opening a new zone on a big game loads faster
items.edited: opening a new city on a big game loads faster and no longer gets stuck at 90% for minutes

items.text: each city downloads about 45% less data (new york 4.1 MB, was 7.6 MB)
items.edited: each city downloads about 45% less data

items.text: edits on big networks calculate trips faster
items.edited: trips are calculated faster after headway changes on big networks

items.text: after an update, a game loads with the last version's trips while the new ones are calculated
the track ghost keeps up with the cursor on big worlds
items.edited: more responsive track placement ghost

items.text: drawing track and edits no longer stall for seconds after you pan to a new area of a big world
items.edited: track drawing and edits no longer stall for seconds after panning on a big world

items.text: on an iphone or ipad, a big saved game warns before it loads, and a game that ran out of memory can be opened without calculating trips
items.edited: on an iphone or ipad, a big saved game warns before it loads

items.text: big games no longer recalculate all their trips now and then to free memory
items.edited: big games no longer recalculate all their trips now and then

items.text: fixed loads that sat for over 10 minutes on a slow connection waiting for water data
edits on a big world show up faster, deleting a line or a station most of all
items.edited: faster / more responsive edit speed

items.text: added georgia, armenia, azerbaijan and afghanistan
items.edited: added georgia, armenia, azerbaijan and afghanistan!

items.text: after 2 hours of play, phones and tablets get a note on how to install the game as an app, which keeps saves past safari's 7-day clearing on iphone
items.edited: can install trainsworld as an app!

items.text: added a download button to every saved game on the start menu and in the saves panel, also for games that won't open
items.edited: added a download button to every saved game, including ones that won't open

items.text: hold shift while clicking delete or remove to skip the question
items.edited: hold shift while clicking delete or remove to skip confirmation

items.text: added help panels for demand and effective time
items.edited: added a help panel explaining effective time, in the trip panel

items.text: buses speed up and slow down at stops instead of jumping to full speed
items.edited: more realistic bus acceleration near stops

items.text: the bus tool tints the ground in town, where BRT runs faster than a plain bus
items.edited: the bus tool tints urban areas, where BRT runs faster than buses

items.text: station upgrades, passages and station buildings now cost upkeep, 0.1% of their price per day: a waiting room is $5k per day and park and ride $20k
items.edited: station upgrades cost upkeep, 0.2% of price per day

items.text: fixed searching while the game runs freezing the tab and stopping trains
items.edited: fixed a freeze when ctrl+f searching while unpaused

items.text: grouping lines, ending a line at a stop and editing bus and ferry routes show up at once
fixed the loading time left jumping from seconds to minutes
fixed the track ghost jumping back to the previous start for a moment after a click
fixed the track ghost pointing far off after zooming, until the mouse moved
the bus tool's urban area highlight is fainter
added brt stations: place one with the station tool beside a road. only brt lines stop there, and people come to it from as far as to any station
items.edited: added brt stations beside roads for brt lines only, drawing trips from as far as any station

items.text: fixed trips home going missing at stations people only drive to
fixed errand, leisure and school trips treating trams as trains, so a busy tram line carries fewer riders
items.edited: fixed trams being counted as trains for errands, outings and trips across a zone line, so a busy tram line carries fewer riders

items.text: fixed undo after copying a line or making a new one leaving the line behind
items.edited: fixed undo leaving a copied or newly created line behind

items.text: a high-speed, ferry or bus line's fare multiple row shows the kind's multiple, so you can see why it costs more
items.edited: fixed a high-speed, ferry or bus line's fare multiple showing 1.00x when its riders pay that kind's multiple

items.text: search finds towns anywhere in the world
community cards show which networks you liked
added the Discord and leaderboards links to Community, and report is now a flag icon that asks which problem before sending
items.edited: added the leaderboards link to Community, and report is now a flag icon that asks which problem before sending

items.text: bus-heavy games calculate trips 20-40% faster and use 20-40% less memory
items.edited: bus-heavy games calculate trips 20-40% faster, and about 20% faster still on belgrade (16 min to 13 min)

items.text: a second change made soon after another starts calculating trips again at once, so two changes a minute apart on a big map are calculated in about half the time
items.edited: trips after two edits a minute apart are calculated in about half the time

items.text: the game uses about 60 MB less memory on big networks
big games use 100-250 MB less memory on phones
zoom buttons are off by default on phones (turn them on in settings)
fixed riders on new lines changing again just after trips were calculated, when one edit reached two new cities
big games use 10-60 MB less memory
removed the discord link from the community tab
people walk up to 1 km to a bus stop, up from 600 m
the drop marker in the lines list starts at the group's indent when a line will go into a group
a saved game no longer calculates its trips again after an update, unless the update changed how trips work
after an edit on a save with no quick first pass (the New York save), lines' riders start moving once the first period's trips are calculated, about 35 s instead of 75 s
loading a big game in chrome uses up to 200 MB less memory
fixed commutes and outings across a zone line treating trams as trains, so a busy tram line there carries fewer riders
placing a station on a big world shows up faster
a line's new path shows up as soon as you add or remove a stop, and a deleted line is gone at once
undoing an edit shows up at once
the Lines tab's New line button, copying a line and changing its colour or settings show up faster
placing or deleting a station, deleting track and changing a station in its panel show up at the click
constructing and editing selected track shows up at once
the lines tab's figures update sooner after an edit on big games
trips are calculated about 20% faster on bus-heavy maps (belgrade 16 min to 13 min)
added an Auto choice to the station tool that picks train station, tram stop, BRT station or port from what is under the pointer
items.edited: added an Auto choice to the station tool that picks train station, tram stop, BRT station or port from what is under the pointer; a BRT station shows trips within 600 m

items.text: brt lines on the same road share their bus lanes, paid for once with the upkeep split
the game uses 30-40 MB less memory on big networks like the tokyo real network
the map credits start folded into the (i) button
fixed the lines list hiding money on a narrow panel when other columns were off
when the train simulation stops working, the game says so and lets you leave to the menu
fixed the map's hover staying up over panels
on a computer, a game that runs out of memory while loading loads again by itself with fewer cores
fixed the demand bubbles staying on screen after turning them off when the graphics context was lost
fixed searching community networks by place missing ones built there but earning no points yet (applies to networks shared again)
fixed the page stopping at startup right after the browser's graphics crashed
fixed city labels showing on top of the tutorial card
fixed edits failing one after another with no way out after the track model stopped; the game now asks you to reload
fixed stations on curved track sometimes being refused for track over water at a ramp far away
fixed track drawn onto the end of other track being refused when one end was almost in line with the other
